red_cell_share_of_blood_radioactivity_pc.quote: the percent radioactivity distributed into red blood cells (44–36%) approximated the mean hematocrit value (41–43%). These data suggest that lenalidomide, as the primary radioactive component in circulation, is distributed nearly equally between cellular and plasma components of whole blood.

limits: Total radioactivity, not lenalidomide alone; lenalidomide was 92% of plasma radioactivity AUC (Table 2).
Six healthy men after one dose; not measured in myeloma or in kidney impairment.
Assumes drug in red cells is available to the kidney within one pass (rapid exchange between cells and plasma); not measured.
